test_ProxyAuthHandler_get_auth_headers: test the ProxyAuthHandler to return Bearer Authorization headers for a given credential and scope
test_ProxyAuthHandler_token_caching: test the ProxyAuthHandler token caching so repeated calls reuse the same cached token
test_GenericOAuth2Credential_token_reque: test the GenericOAuth2Credential to make a client_credentials OAuth2 token request with correct parameters
test_AzureADCredential_wraps_credential: test the AzureADCredential to wrap an azure-identity credential and return an AccessToken
test_litellm_proxy_auth_integration: test that litellm.proxy_auth can be set to a ProxyAuthHandler instance for global auth
